_comment: Panic-prone Rust constructs, used by panic-safety-checker. A panic that crosses the FFI boundary is caught by PyO3 (raised as PanicException) but is almost never intended; a panic crossing a non-PyO3 extern "C" boundary aborts the process.

notes.index_expression: Indexing a slice/Vec/array with `[i]` panics on out-of-bounds; flagged via the index_expression node. `.get(i)` returns Option instead.
notes.arithmetic: a + b / a - b / a * b / a << b panic on overflow when overflow-checks are enabled (the default for debug builds). Worth a CONSIDER note, not a FIX.
notes.division: a / b and a % b panic on division by zero.
notes.unwrap_unchecked: `unwrap_unchecked` is unsafe and is UB (not a panic) on the None/Err case -- belongs to unsafe-block-auditor as well.
notes.panicking_slice_methods: Vec::remove/insert were excluded: the names collide with non-panicking HashMap/HashSet/BTreeMap methods, and a syntactic scanner cannot tell the receiver type apart -- they were pure false-positive noise.
